- N=8 samples per instance
- T=1.0
- Micro-F1 评估
- seed=42

  --model gpt-5.5 \
  --base_url http://47.94.22.126/v1 \
  --api_key tum_XXB3sZILRCg8llb3NjxVbbRNzFpsYVFdiogFkavpGn8 \
  --data_dir data/fewnerd/ \
  --dataset fewnerd \
  --n_instances 200 \
